metadata.title: [Duplicate — see 10.5281/zenodo.24387075] Public Database of Backlink Spam Doorway Domains, Link-Selling Networks, and Checkout Link Abuse (2026)
metadata.description:
What changed in this version (version 2, 22 November 2026). This record is a duplicate, created by mistake on 20 November 2026 when the same upload ran twice; version 1 held the same files as 10.5281/zenodo.24387076. Version 1's figures are wrong. It was titled as a database of domains but held no domains, only three "patterns", two of which had no source. This version removes those files and keeps only a note.

Use 10.5281/zenodo.24387075 instead ("Backlink Spam List: 581 Doorway Domains and Link Sellers with Public Evidence (Snapshot of 28 October 2026)"); that DOI always points to the newest version of the corrected record. Please do not cite this record.
